title: Log-space computation implies polynomial time
statement: Let $f$ be a function on bit strings, let $M$ be a finite Turing machine, and let $c$ be a natural number. If for every input $x$ there is a time $t$ such that $M$ halts on $x$ with output $f(x)$ after $t$ steps and uses at most $c(\log_2 |x|+1)$ work-tape cells through step $t$, then $f$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps bit strings to bit strings.
